passages.text: Arise, shine, for your light has come, and the glory of the LORD rises upon you.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Zion.
God commands Zion to arise.
God tells Zion to shine.
Zion’s light has come.
The glory of the LORD rises upon Zion.
passages.original: ק֥וּמִי א֖וֹרִי כִּ֣י בָ֣א אוֹרֵ֑ךְ וּכְב֥וֹד יְהוָ֖ה עָלַ֥יִךְ זָרָֽח׃

passages.text: For behold, darkness covers the earth, and thick darkness is over the peoples; but the LORD will rise upon you, and His glory will appear over you.
passages.sermon:
Darkness covers the earth.
Thick darkness covers all peoples.
The LORD rises upon you.
His glory appears over you.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ הִנֵּ֤ה הַחֹ֙שֶׁךְ֙ יְכַסֶּה־ אֶ֔רֶץ וַעֲרָפֶ֖ל לְאֻמִּ֑ים וְעָלַ֙יִךְ֙ יִזְרַ֣ח יְהוָ֔ה וּכְבוֹד֖וֹ עָלַ֥יִךְ יֵרָאֶֽה׃

passages.text: Nations will come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your dawn.
passages.sermon:
Nations will come to your light.
Kings will come to the brightness of your dawn.
God gives you this light.
God causes your dawn to shine brightly.
God’s glory draws nations and kings to you.
passages.original: וְהָלְכ֥וּ גוֹיִ֖ם לְאוֹרֵ֑ךְ וּמְלָכִ֖ים לְנֹ֥גַהּ זַרְחֵֽךְ׃

passages.text: Lift up your eyes and look around: They all gather and come to you; your sons will come from afar, and your daughters will be carried on the arm.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people, Jerusalem.
He tells Jerusalem to lift up her eyes.
He tells her to look around.
All the people gather together.
They all come to Jerusalem.
Her sons come from far away.
Her daughters are carried in loving arms.
passages.original: שְׂאִֽי־ סָבִ֤יב עֵינַ֙יִךְ֙ וּרְאִ֔י כֻּלָּ֖ם נִקְבְּצ֣וּ בָֽאוּ־ לָ֑ךְ בָּנַ֙יִךְ֙ מֵרָח֣וֹק יָבֹ֔אוּ וּבְנֹתַ֖יִךְ עַל־ צַ֥ד תֵּאָמַֽנָה׃

passages.text: Then you will look and be radiant, and your heart will tremble and swell with joy, because the riches of the sea will be brought to you, and the wealth of the nations will come to you.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Jerusalem.
God promises Jerusalem a time of blessing.
You will look around.
You will shine with joy.
Your heart will tremble.
Your heart will grow wide with happiness.
The riches of the sea will come to you.
The wealth of many nations will come to you.
passages.original: אָ֤ז תִּרְאִי֙ וְנָהַ֔רְתְּ וּפָחַ֥ד וְרָחַ֖ב לְבָבֵ֑ךְ כִּֽי־ יֵהָפֵ֤ךְ עָלַ֙יִךְ֙ הֲמ֣וֹן יָ֔ם חֵ֥יל גּוֹיִ֖ם יָבֹ֥אוּ לָֽךְ׃

passages.text: Caravans of camels will cover your land, young camels of Midian and Ephah, and all from Sheba will come, bearing gold and frankincense and proclaiming the praises of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people Israel.
He promises a time of blessing.
Many camels will fill your land.
Young camels from Midian will come.
Young camels from Ephah will come.
People from Sheba will come too.
They will bring gold.
They will bring frankincense.
They will proclaim the praises of the LORD.
passages.original: שִֽׁפְעַ֨ת גְּמַלִּ֜ים תְּכַסֵּ֗ךְ בִּכְרֵ֤י מִדְיָן֙ וְעֵיפָ֔ה כֻּלָּ֖ם מִשְּׁבָ֣א יָבֹ֑אוּ זָהָ֤ב וּלְבוֹנָה֙ יִשָּׂ֔אוּ וּתְהִלֹּ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה יְבַשֵּֽׂרוּ׃

passages.text: All the flocks of Kedar will be gathered to you; the rams of Nebaioth will serve you and go up on My altar with acceptance; I will adorn My glorious house.
passages.sermon:
All the flocks of Kedar will come together for you.
The rams of Nebaioth will serve you.
They will go up on My altar.
I will accept them.
I will make My glorious house beautiful.
passages.original: כָּל־ צֹ֤אן קֵדָר֙ יִקָּ֣בְצוּ לָ֔ךְ אֵילֵ֥י נְבָי֖וֹת יְשָׁרְת֑וּנֶךְ יַעֲל֤וּ עַל־ רָצוֹן֙ מִזְבְּחִ֔י וּבֵ֥ית תִּפְאַרְתִּ֖י אֲפָאֵֽר׃

passages.text: Who are these who fly like clouds, like doves to their shelters?
passages.sermon:
The prophet Isaiah speaks to Jerusalem.
He sees people coming quickly.
They move like clouds in the sky.
They fly like doves returning to their homes.
Isaiah asks, “Who are these people?”
passages.original: מִי־ אֵ֖לֶּה כָּעָ֣ב תְּעוּפֶ֑ינָה וְכַיּוֹנִ֖ים אֶל־ אֲרֻבֹּתֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Surely the islands will wait for Me, with the ships of Tarshish in the lead, to bring your children from afar, with their silver and gold, to the honor of the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, for He has glorified you.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people Israel.
God is the LORD.
God is the Holy One of Israel.
God has glorified Israel.
The distant islands wait for God.
The ships of Tarshish come first.
The ships bring your children from far away.
The ships bring silver and gold with them.
They bring these gifts for the honor of the LORD your God.
They bring these gifts for the Holy One of Israel.
God has made you glorious.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ לִ֣י׀ אִיִּ֣ים יְקַוּ֗וּ וָאֳנִיּ֤וֹת תַּרְשִׁישׁ֙ בָּרִ֣אשֹׁנָ֔ה לְהָבִ֤יא בָנַ֙יִךְ֙ מֵֽרָח֔וֹק כַּסְפָּ֥ם וּזְהָבָ֖ם אִתָּ֑ם לְשֵׁם֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהַ֔יִךְ וְלִקְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כִּ֥י פֵאֲרָֽךְ׃

passages.text: Foreigners will rebuild your walls, and their kings will serve you. Although I struck you in anger, yet in favor I will show you mercy.
passages.sermon:
Foreigners will rebuild your walls.
Their kings will serve you.
I struck you in anger.
I will show you mercy because I am pleased with you.
passages.original: וּבָנ֤וּ בְנֵֽי־ נֵכָר֙ חֹמֹתַ֔יִךְ וּמַלְכֵיהֶ֖ם יְשָׁרְת֑וּנֶךְ כִּ֤י בְקִצְפִּי֙ הִכִּיתִ֔יךְ וּבִרְצוֹנִ֖י רִֽחַמְתִּֽיךְ׃

passages.text: Your gates will always stand open; they will never be shut, day or night, so that the wealth of the nations may be brought into you, with their kings being led in procession.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Zion, the city of the Holy One of Israel.
Your gates will always stand open.
No one will close your gates, day or night.
People will bring the wealth of the nations to you.
Their kings will come, led in procession.
passages.original: וּפִתְּח֨וּ שְׁעָרַ֧יִךְ תָּמִ֛יד יוֹמָ֥ם וָלַ֖יְלָה לֹ֣א יִסָּגֵ֑רוּ לְהָבִ֤יא אֵלַ֙יִךְ֙ חֵ֣יל גּוֹיִ֔ם וּמַלְכֵיהֶ֖ם נְהוּגִֽים׃

passages.text: For the nation or kingdom that will not serve you will perish; it will be utterly destroyed.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Zion, the Holy City of Israel.
God says, “Any nation that does not serve you will perish.
Any kingdom that refuses to serve you will be destroyed.
All such nations will become completely ruined.”
passages.original: כִּֽי־ הַגּ֧וֹי וְהַמַּמְלָכָ֛ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ יַעַבְד֖וּךְ יֹאבֵ֑דוּ וְהַגּוֹיִ֖ם חָרֹ֥ב יֶחֱרָֽבוּ׃

passages.text: The glory of Lebanon will come to you— its cypress, elm, and boxwood together— to adorn the place of My sanctuary, and I will glorify the place of My feet.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Zion, the city of the Holy One of Israel.
The glory of Lebanon will come to you.
Cypress trees will come to you.
Elm trees will come to you.
Boxwood trees will come to you.
All these trees will come together.
They will make My sanctuary beautiful.
I will honor the place where My feet rest.
passages.original: כְּב֤וֹד הַלְּבָנוֹן֙ אֵלַ֣יִךְ יָב֔וֹא בְּר֛וֹשׁ תִּדְהָ֥ר וּתְאַשּׁ֖וּר יַחְדָּ֑ו לְפָאֵר֙ מְק֣וֹם מִקְדָּשִׁ֔י וּמְק֥וֹם רַגְלַ֖י אֲכַבֵּֽד׃

passages.text: The sons of your oppressors will come and bow down to you; all who reviled you will fall facedown at your feet and call you the City of the LORD, Zion of the Holy One of Israel.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Zion, the city of the Holy One of Israel.
Your oppressors have sons.
These sons will come to you.
They will walk toward you in humility.
They will bow down before you.
All who hated you will come.
They will fall facedown at your feet.
They will call you by a new name.
They will say, “You are the City of the LORD.”
They will call you “Zion, the Holy One of Israel.”
passages.original: וְהָלְכ֨וּ אֵלַ֤יִךְ שְׁח֙וֹחַ֙ בְּנֵ֣י מְעַנַּ֔יִךְ וְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲו֛וּ עַל־ כַּפּ֥וֹת רַגְלַ֖יִךְ כָּל־ מְנַֽאֲצָ֑יִךְ וְקָ֤רְאוּ לָךְ֙ עִ֣יר יְהוָ֔ה צִיּ֖וֹן קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Whereas you have been forsaken and despised, with no one passing through, I will make you an everlasting pride, a joy from age to age.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Zion.
Zion was once forsaken.
People abandoned Zion.
Zion was despised.
No one passed through Zion.
God will change this.
God will make Zion a source of everlasting pride.
God will make Zion a joy for every generation.
passages.original: תַּ֧חַת הֱיוֹתֵ֛ךְ עֲזוּבָ֥ה וּשְׂנוּאָ֖ה וְאֵ֣ין עוֹבֵ֑ר וְשַׂמְתִּיךְ֙ לִגְא֣וֹן עוֹלָ֔ם מְשׂ֖וֹשׂ דּ֥וֹר וָדֽוֹר׃

passages.text: You will drink the milk of nations and nurse at the breasts of royalty; you will know that I, the LORD, am your Savior and your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks to Zion.
Zion is the city of the Holy One of Israel.
Zion will receive blessings from many nations.
You will drink the milk of nations.
You will nurse at the breasts of royalty.
You will know that I am the LORD.
I am your Savior.
I am your Redeemer.
I am the Mighty One of Jacob.
passages.original: וְיָנַקְתְּ֙ חֲלֵ֣ב גּוֹיִ֔ם וְשֹׁ֥ד מְלָכִ֖ים תִּינָ֑קִי וְיָדַ֗עַתְּ כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ מֽוֹשִׁיעֵ֔ךְ וְגֹאֲלֵ֖ךְ אֲבִ֥יר יַעֲקֹֽב׃

passages.text: Instead of bronze I will bring you gold; I will bring silver in place of iron, bronze instead of wood, and iron instead of stones. I will appoint peace as your governor and righteousness as your ruler.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
God promises to change their situation.
God will take away bronze.
God will give gold instead.
God will take away iron.
God will give silver instead.
God will take away wood.
God will give bronze instead.
God will take away stones.
God will give iron instead.
God will appoint peace to rule over them.
God will appoint righteousness to lead them.
passages.original: תַּ֣חַת הַנְּחֹ֜שֶׁת אָבִ֣יא זָהָ֗ב וְתַ֤חַת הַבַּרְזֶל֙ אָ֣בִיא כֶ֔סֶף וְתַ֤חַת הָֽעֵצִים֙ נְחֹ֔שֶׁת וְתַ֥חַת הָאֲבָנִ֖ים בַּרְזֶ֑ל וְשַׂמְתִּ֤י פְקֻדָּתֵךְ֙ שָׁל֔וֹם וְנֹגְשַׂ֖יִךְ צְדָקָֽה׃

passages.text: No longer will violence be heard in your land, nor ruin or destruction within your borders. But you will name your walls Salvation and your gates Praise.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
God promises safety and peace in their land.
No one will hear violence in your land.
No one will hear ruin or destruction within your borders.
You will call your walls Salvation.
You will call your gates Praise.
passages.original: לֹא־ יִשָּׁמַ֨ע ע֤וֹד חָמָס֙ בְּאַרְצֵ֔ךְ שֹׁ֥ד וָשֶׁ֖בֶר בִּגְבוּלָ֑יִךְ וְקָרָ֤את יְשׁוּעָה֙ חוֹמֹתַ֔יִךְ וּשְׁעָרַ֖יִךְ תְּהִלָּֽה׃

passages.text: No longer will the sun be your light by day, nor the brightness of the moon shine on your night; for the LORD will be your everlasting light, and your God will be your splendor.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
He promises a new way of life.
The sun will not be your light during the day.
The moon will not shine on you at night.
The LORD will be your everlasting light.
Your God will be your splendor.
passages.original: לֹא־ יִֽהְיֶה־ לָּ֨ךְ ע֤וֹד הַשֶּׁ֙מֶשׁ֙ לְא֣וֹר יוֹמָ֔ם וּלְנֹ֕גַהּ הַיָּרֵ֖חַ לֹא־ יָאִ֣יר לָ֑ךְ וְהָיָה־ לָ֤ךְ יְהוָה֙ לְא֣וֹר עוֹלָ֔ם וֵאלֹהַ֖יִךְ לְתִפְאַרְתֵּֽךְ׃

passages.text: Your sun will no longer set, and your moon will not wane; for the LORD will be your everlasting light, and the days of your sorrow will cease.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your everlasting light.
Your sun will not set again.
Your moon will not fade away.
The days of your sorrow will end.
passages.original: לֹא־ יָב֥וֹא עוֹד֙ שִׁמְשֵׁ֔ךְ וִירֵחֵ֖ךְ לֹ֣א יֵאָסֵ֑ף כִּ֣י יְהוָ֗ה יִֽהְיֶה־ לָּךְ֙ לְא֣וֹר עוֹלָ֔ם וְשָׁלְמ֖וּ יְמֵ֥י אֶבְלֵֽךְ׃

passages.text: Then all your people will be righteous; they will possess the land forever; they are the branch of My planting, the work of My hands, so that I may be glorified.
passages.sermon:
All your people will be righteous.
They will possess the land forever.
They are the branch that I have planted.
They are the work of My hands.
I do this so that I may be glorified.
passages.original: וְעַמֵּךְ֙ כֻּלָּ֣ם צַדִּיקִ֔ים לְעוֹלָ֖ם יִ֣ירְשׁוּ אָ֑רֶץ נֵ֧צֶר מַטָּעוֹ מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָדַ֖י לְהִתְפָּאֵֽר׃

passages.text: The least of you will become a thousand, and the smallest a mighty nation. I am the LORD; in its time I will accomplish it quickly.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks to His people.
The LORD is powerful and faithful.
The least person among you will become a thousand people.
The smallest person among you will become a mighty nation.
I am the LORD.
At the right time, I will make this happen quickly.
passages.original: הַקָּטֹן֙ יִֽהְיֶ֣ה לָאֶ֔לֶף וְהַצָּעִ֖יר לְג֣וֹי עָצ֑וּם אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בְּעִתָּ֥הּ אֲחִישֶֽׁנָּה׃ס
